scarcity.def: The basic problem that resources are limited while wants are unlimited, so people, firms and governments must choose.

factors-of-production.def: The resources used to make goods and services: land (natural resources), labor (human effort), capital (tools, machines and buildings) and entrepreneurship (organizing and taking risks).

trade-off.def: Giving up some of one thing to get more of another; every choice under scarcity involves one.

opportunity-cost.def: The value of the next-best alternative given up when you make a choice; only the single next-best option counts.
